name: Token Desk
summary: A clinic front desk in Lahore: a token board that flips to the next number and a live wait ring per doctor
about: A nine-page front desk for a family clinic in Johar Town, Lahore, with four rooms and six doctors. Call the next patient and the split-flap token board flips to the new number while its chime light glows and ripples; every doctor has a live ring that fills as the wait grows and turns coral past the target. Appointments, patients with visit history, a pharmacy counter with stock, lab orders with results, billing in PKR with cash, card and company panels, reports and settings all work.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Today's queue, Appointments, Doctors and shifts, Patients, Pharmacy, Lab tests, Billing, Reports or Settings
Press New token to issue a token for a registered or new patient, then watch it join the doctor's column
Pick a room on the token board and press Call next: the number flips and the chime light rings; use Recall or Skip when someone is missing
Book appointments in the day planner, check patients in, and confirm online requests
Dispense prescriptions, restock medicines, move lab orders from sample to report, and take payments or send panel claims
Press Ctrl+K to search patients, tokens and medicines; switch the report range between 7, 30 and 90 days
Change the wait target, auto-call and chime in Settings, or reset the demo data
